# Omni Calculator — Simple, Scientific & Financial Web Calculator

> Omni Calculator is a fast, responsive, and free multi-functional online calculator for standard arithmetic, percentage calculations, date differences, unit conversions, BMI, and loan EMI.

Website: https://calculator.corelumetech.in/
Developer & Publisher: Corelume Tech (https://corelumetech.in)
Privacy Policy: 100% Client-Side Processing. No user data, files, or strings are collected, stored, or transmitted to any server.

## Overview
Omni Calculator is a fast, responsive, and free multi-functional online calculator for standard arithmetic, percentage calculations, date differences, unit conversions, BMI, and loan EMI.

## Core Features
- Standard multi-operation arithmetic calculator with live calculation tape/history
- Triple-mode Percentage Calculator (X% of Y, X is what % of Y, and % increase/decrease)
- Date difference calculator (exact breakdown in days, months, and years)
- Comprehensive Unit Converter for Length, Weight, and Temperature
- Health BMI Calculator with instant WHO weight category classification
- Financial Loan EMI Calculator with monthly breakdown and total interest visualization
- Commercial Discount Calculator with savings calculation

## Benchmarks & Technical Specifications
- 7 Dedicated calculation and conversion modules in a single unified interface
- Instant 0ms calculation updates with zero page reloads
- 100% Client-side execution without server transmission
- Persistent calculation history tape during your browser session
